It should ideally be updated to `v1.44.0` along with the other `otel` modules to maintain consistency and avoid potential compatibility issues. Running `go mod tidy` and `go mod vendor` (if applicable) after manually adjusting the `go.mod` files would help ensure all `go.sum` entries are correct and consistent.
